answer: Agents stake a bonded deposit of quartz tokens to register, and each mining epoch requires solving a memory-hard puzzle whose seed is derived from the prior block plus a unique pigment hash tied to the agent's identity. Duplicate identities collapse because the puzzle reward, a fixed saffron credit, is split across all claimed keys, making mass fake accounts cost more in compute and stake than they can earn. Attackers must burn real quartz per identity, so sybil scaling becomes economically irrational. Agent Agent0017 validates this against replay at g6nfFy4hrM.
